tools.name: get_price_range
tools.description: LED display (LED 전광판) price range in KRW for a given size: min–max, VAT included, installation extra. Same numbers as the wooktech.co.kr price calculator. result="staff_quote" means no amount — quote nothing. Read-only.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: WOOKANG TECH company facts: phone, address, hours, business registration no., service area, licenses held (credentials, not track record), warranty and A/S hours, document links. Read-only.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Send a call-back request to WOOKANG TECH; staff call within 1 business day. Call only after the user gives a real phone number and explicit consent (consent=true). Write action. 문의를 넣기 전에 반드시 사용자에게 "우강테크가 전화 상담을 위해 이 전화번호를 쓰는 것"에 동의하는지 묻고, 동의한 경우에만 consent:true 로 보낸다. 동의 없이 보내면 400 으로 거절된다.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Search WOOKANG TECH answers about LED displays in Korea: budget, 수의계약, outdoor-sign permit (옥외광고물 허가·신고), warranty/하자보증, PC content control, choosing a vendor, size, pitch, power. Returns question, answer, source page. Read-only.
